about.aiBio: I am João Miguel Marcondes, a multimedia professional based in Leiria with a strong focus on technology and design. I combine audiovisual editing, web development, and technical support to turn ideas into useful outcomes. I learn fast, adapt to new contexts, and value clear communication to deliver consistent, creative work aligned with team and client needs.
